explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/976: F_f(n) is the greatest prime divisor of ∏_{m≤n} f(m) for irreducible f ∈ ℤ[x] of degree d ≥ 2.  is maxPrimeFac of |∏_{m∈[1,n]} f(m)|; there are no integer roots, so the product is nonzero. The question: is F_f(n) ≫ n^{1+c} for some c > 0? The statement asserts, for every irreducible f of degree ≥ 2, some c > 0 with n^{1+c} = O(F f n). Faithful.
